method: Parse actual RS274X copper and Excellon drills independently; require each native-policy-approved wire strip on its designated outer copper layer after drilled voids are removed. Actual CAM net-island assignment, spacing, source equality and archive equality must separately PASS. Analytic rounding tolerance 0.0002 mm. Native bounded fanouts and resistor-only leaves remain explicitly distinguished from main-width strips.
via_path_scope: Minimum available via-layer changes in actual plated-drill/copper-island topology; total branched via counts remain in the native policy. Does not model current splitting, distributed resistance, temperatures or hardware operation. Native component PTH contacts are not counted as routing vias.
